description: Every code the index job, the merge and the selection write (ADR 0020 to ADR 0025), with the US-English default text the app renders through the String Catalog. Logs, events, results and the database carry these codes and their parameters, never prose. `{name}` in a text is a parameter: for checks and reasons it comes from params_json, for status lines and source states the app supplies it.

read.description: files.code of a file of kind unreadable, and the keys of check.unreadable_files by_code.

bad_dir.description: bad_dirs.code: a folder the walk could not list.

source.description: Summary codes of a scan of one source (scans.summary_json, the result's sources).

select.description: selection_reason codes. chosen, eligible, excluded and held are the outcome. A reason holds one params object for all its codes, so no two excluded codes share a parameter name.
